subject: Re: RetailPlus UK Mini Summit — co-sponsor playbook & MDF
messages:
From: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@retailplus.co.uk>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: j.holt@retailplus.co.uk
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: RetailPlus UK Mini Summit — co-sponsor inquiry

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the call last week. RetailPlus is running a one-day "UK Mini Summit" in London on Nov 12 focused on in-store AI use cases. We typically host ~150 attendees (mix of retail ops & IT) and have a small expo area with 6 partner tables.

Would Redwood be open to co-sponsoring a partner table + a 20 minute product theatre slot? We're offering marketing development funds (MDF) to cover a portion of booth costs and promotion.

Quick details:
- Venue: King's Hall, London
- Expected attendees: 120–180
- Booth footprint: 2m x 1.5m table + backdrop
- Speaker slot: 20 minutes (technical demo + customer Q&A)
- Promotion: email blast to RetailPlus list (20k), social posts, onsite branding

Can you share: a) approximate MDF expectation from your side b) any booth/tech requirements you have c) whether you can commit a speaker + laptop for demos.

Attached a one-page summary of the event.

Best,
Claire O'Neill
Head of Partnerships
RetailPlus Ltd

Attachments:
- RetailPlus_Event_Summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@retailplus.co.uk>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 11:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: RetailPlus UK Mini Summit — co-sponsor inquiry

Hi Claire — thanks for the note and the summary.

Redwood is interested. Quick answers:
- MDF: we usually budget ~£4k–£6k for events of this scale; happy to discuss a cost-share. Would you be open to a 60/40 split (RetailPlus/Redwood) for core booth costs and promotion?
- Booth/tech: we will need a standard 13" demo laptop, HDMI + power, one AC outlet, and a small monitor (we can bring our own if needed). Also prefer a table near the stage for quick walk-up demos.
- Speaker: yes, we can provide a product lead for the 20 min slot and one customer to join if you can cover travel for the customer.

Next steps: can Sergio own ops logistics for Redwood (booth layout, staffing plan) and Marissa coordinate marketing assets and co-branded promo? If you can share the full requirements doc and any deadlines for assets, we'll produce a playbook and a draft MDF termsheet.

Thanks — Laura

Laura Bennett
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

(Attachment requested)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 08:42:00 +0100
Subject: RE: RetailPlus UK Mini Summit — co-sponsor inquiry

Adding initial ops notes and rough cost breakdown. Attaching RetailPlus floorplan and our draft MDF terms.

Ops + logistics (notes):
- Booth staffing: 2 FTE on-site plus 1 floater (demo rotation) — rotations cover 9:00–17:00
- Materials: pop-up banner, one monitor (24"), literature (50 leaflets), demo laptop (we'll bring), power strip
- Lead capture: recommend iPad + quick form (Zapier -> HubSpot) and QR code to a co-branded landing page

Draft cost split (estimates):
- Booth rental & table: £1,800
- Shell scheme / branding: £2,400
- Promo (email boost / social): £1,200
- Travel & exp (2 pax): £900
Total: £6,300
Proposed split: RetailPlus 60% (£3,780) / Redwood 40% (£2,520)

Open items:
- Who owns post-event leads (shared list + recon call within 2 weeks)
- Any exhibitor insurance or exhibitor-only rules we need to be aware of

Attachments:
- Booth_Floorplan_v2.png
- Draft_MDF_Termsheet.xlsx

Sergio
Senior Events Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@retailplus.co.uk>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: j.holt@retailplus.co.uk
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 14:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: RetailPlus UK Mini Summit — co-sponsor inquiry

Laura / team — thanks, that split works for us.

Confirmed:
- RetailPlus covers 60% of the core costs; Redwood covers 40%. We'll issue an invoice for your contribution once we receive the signed MDF terms.
- Speaker slot confirmed (11:40am). We'll give 20 minutes + 10 mins for Q&A. Please provide speaker bio + headshot by Oct 10.
- We can provide a co-branded landing page and will share the Drive folder with assets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRetailPlusRoadshow

Attached the event requirements pack with AV specs.

I'll also add a short SOW template that you can adapt for DocuSign.

Best,
Claire

Attachments:
- RetailPlus_Roadshow_Requirements.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@retailplus.co.uk>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 10:00:00 +0100
Subject: Re: RetailPlus UK Mini Summit — co-sponsor playbook & MDF

Claire — great, thanks for confirming.

Summary / owners & deadlines:
- MDF termsheet: Sergio to complete and share draft with Claire by Sep 18 (owner: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com)
- Speaker assets: Laura to send bio + headshot by Oct 8 (owner: laura_bennett@redwood.com)
- Marketing assets: Marissa to prepare co-branded email and social tiles; first draft by Oct 3 (owner: marissa_cole@redwood.com)
- Logistics: Sergio to confirm exact booth placement and power requirements by Oct 15 and confirm lead-capture method
- SOW & DocuSign: Claire to share SOW template; Laura will return signed SOW within 5 business days of receipt

Quote from Claire (for clarity):
> "Speaker slot confirmed (11:40am). We'll give 20 minutes + 10 mins for Q&A. Please provide speaker bio + headshot by Oct 10."

Can we also confirm whether RetailPlus will provide a small table skirted (yes/no) and whether we need to book an extension lead for the demo laptop?

Thanks — looking forward to the playbook.

Redwood Inference
